title: Mark reachable objects, sweep the rest
description: You can follow root-based collection through shared nodes and an unreachable cycle.

steps.description: MSHeap stores object dictionaries at integer addresses. Its child scan treats an integer field as a reference when that value names an allocated address.
_mark starts from roots and follows children, skipping already marked objects. _sweep frees unmarked objects and resets surviving marks for the next collection.
You root a, which points to b and c; both share d. The first collection frees the two garbage objects and leaves these four reachable objects.

steps.question: Will the peer links keep x and y alive during the next collection?
steps.answer: No. Neither object is reachable from the root a, so both remain unmarked and are swept.

steps.description: The supplied output shows the cycle increasing the count from four to six. You then see two objects swept and four remaining.
